reference: Imai et al. (ACL 2023 SRW) IE-all baseline — replace Indo-European with a rule-based Asian family union on WikiAnn.
family_source: lang2vec URIEL family_features.npz (F_* top-level family per ISO code)
resolution: WikiAnn config code → ISO 639-3 via lang2vec letter_codes.json
Dialect configs (e.g. zh-classical) → base code before '-' when needed

asian_east_sea.label: East + Southeast Asia (recommended)
asian_east_sea.description: Core East Asian families plus SEA Austronesian/Austroasiatic. Excludes South Asia (Indo-Iranian), West Asia (Semitic), Turkic, Dravidian. Closest to Japan-defense narrative while staying Imai-style (rule union, no hand-picking).

asian_broad.label: Broad Asia (Imai IE-all parallel)
asian_broad.description: Larger union: East/SE Asia plus South/West/Central Asia branches represented in WikiAnn (Indo-Iranian, Semitic, Turkic, Dravidian, Kartvelian).

asian_core.label: East Asia core (minimal)
asian_core.description: Smallest defensible set: no Austronesian SEA expansion. Good for smoke tests only.

eval_policy: Evaluate on all pool languages (not mn-only). Report low_resource_macro_f1 for train<=500 stratum within pool.
train_policy: Per-condition clustering/random selection inside pool (unchanged harness).
